sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the main game, see Events.

Events in Escape from Tarkov: Arena are limited time activities that give players new challenges, adjust gameplay & mechanics, and introduce new items that are being tested by the developers for a limited time. Some events are "lore-oriented" which give an insight or backstory to the Tarkov/Norvinsk region, while other events are seasonal holiday events that are done just for fun.

sections.heading: CheckChamber (31 July 2026)
sections.text:
"Ref's supply operation has hit a snag: the magazines were lost in transit, and there are no replacements available just yet. But the show must go on."
- Quest Musketeers has been added.
- Quest Unsurpassed Skill has been added.
- Quest No Man Is an Island has been added.
- Quest The Old-Fashioned Way has been added.
- Quest Magazines Are for the Weak has been added.
- New game mode "CheckChamber" has been added.
  - Matches in this mode provide double EXP.
  - Weapons in this mode do not have a magazine attached and there are no spare magazines available in the gear presets.
  - All weapons have to be reloaded through the chamber after each shot.
  - One of the following weapons is randomly assigned each life:

sections.heading: TeamFight Playtest (7 May 2026)
sections.text:
- The Capture Point now appears 20–40 seconds after the gates open, depending on the Arena size.
- The Cleanup Crew spawns 60 seconds after the Capture Point appears.
- The Poison phase begins 20 seconds after the Cleanup Crew enters the field.
- Total round duration (from gate opening to Poison activation) has been reduced from 155 seconds to 90 seconds.
- TeamFight no longer has class restrictions within a team.
- Capture time has been reduced to 7 seconds (except on the “Bowl” map).
- Capture speed now scales with the number of players involved, similar to the CheckPoint mode.
- During the event, all TeamFight rewards are increased by 50% (including Arena BattlePass XP).
